title: Harrington tours the Greenbrier bunker
summary: John Harrington tells of Harrington tours the Greenbrier bunker, about 1986-1987 at Greenbrier, West Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was later when I was secretary of energy. I got to see that cuz we were down at Greenbryer. I think it was Greenbryer playing golf and I went and toured that thing.

plain: John Harrington, who says he served as US Secretary of Energy, says that around 1986 or 1987 he was at Greenbrier in West Virginia playing golf. He says that while there he went and toured a hidden bunker, a place he says he only got to see because of his job.
